films.desc_en: A father secures his home against a storm using a modern digital insurance service, ensuring his family's peace of mind.
films.music: warm cinematic acoustic guitar building to an uplifting climax, 90 bpm

shots.kf: A man standing on a modern balcony in Skopje, looking at dark storm clouds rolling over Mount Vodno. He is in his 40s, with a short brown beard, wearing a grey wool sweater and blue jeans. Soft diffused lighting, medium wide shot, cinematic lens, moody cool color palette, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The dark storm clouds slowly drift across the sky while the camera gently pushes in toward the man's face.

shots.kf: The same man in his 40s with a short brown beard, wearing a grey wool sweater, looking through a rain-streaked living room window from the inside. Dim interior lighting, shadows creeping in, focus on the raindrops on the glass, melancholic blue tones, highly detailed, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Raindrops slowly slide down the glass window pane while the camera subtly pans to the right.

shots.kf: A close-up of a sleek modern smartphone held in a hand, a warm golden light emitting from the blank screen. The same man, in his 40s with a short brown beard wearing a grey wool sweater, is visible in the soft-focus background looking relieved. Warm ambient light, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The golden light on the man's face subtly pulses and glows brighter as the camera slowly tilts up.

shots.kf: The same man in his 40s with a short brown beard and grey wool sweater, sitting comfortably on a modern sofa wrapped in a blanket. Warm firelight flickers in the room, creating a cozy and safe atmosphere. Medium shot, inviting golden and orange color palette, highly detailed, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The firelight gently flickers across the room and the man's face while the camera slowly tracks to the left.

shots.kf: The same man in his 40s with a short brown beard, wearing a grey wool sweater and blue jeans, standing proudly in front of a beautiful modern house on a sunny day. Bright blue sky, vibrant green lawn, wide shot, warm daylight, high contrast, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The man gently turns his head to smile at the house while the camera slowly pulls back to reveal the property.

films.desc_en: A woman experiences a car breakdown on a scenic road trip but is quickly rescued by a seamless roadside assistance service.
films.music: upbeat ambient electronic pop with a steady groove, 110 bpm
vo_mk: Ние сме секогаш тука за вас.

shots.kf: A woman driving a sleek silver car along a scenic winding road next to the sparkling blue waters of Lake Ohrid. She is in her 30s, with curly red hair, wearing a beige trench coat and black sunglasses. Bright sunny daylight, medium shot from the dashboard, vibrant colors, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The car glides smoothly forward along the curved road as the camera slowly pans across the beautiful lake scenery.

shots.kf: The same woman in her 30s with curly red hair and a beige trench coat, standing beside her parked silver car on the road's shoulder. White steam is gently rising from the car's hood. Overcast soft lighting, medium wide shot, slightly desaturated tones, photorealistic.
shots.motion: White steam billows slowly upward from the car engine while the camera slowly pushes in towards the woman.

shots.kf: The same woman in her 30s with curly red hair and a beige trench coat, tapping a blank modern smartphone screen. A blurred yellow assistance vehicle is smoothly pulling up in the soft-focus background behind her. Cinematic depth of field, natural daylight, crisp focus on the phone, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The blurred yellow vehicle in the background slowly glides to a halt while the camera remains perfectly still.

shots.kf: The same woman in her 30s with curly red hair and a beige trench coat, sitting comfortably in the passenger seat of a modern towing truck cabin, holding a blank white coffee cup. Warm afternoon sunlight streaming through the window, shallow depth of field, relaxed atmosphere, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Dust motes dance slowly in the warm sunbeams inside the cabin while the camera gently tracks to the right.

shots.kf: The same woman in her 30s with curly red hair and a beige trench coat, leaning confidently against her fully repaired silver car at a gorgeous sunset overlook near the lake. Golden hour lighting highlighting her relaxed smile, wide cinematic shot, warm orange and pink hues, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The golden sunset light softly shifts across the car's metallic surface while the camera slowly pulls backward.

films.desc_en: A single, coherent vertical story set on Skopje’s Vardar quay: one small business owner spills coffee on a laptop, files a claim on her phone, and receives a payout notification moments later. Same hero, same outfit and props, natural Balkan atmosphere with signage-free backgrounds, ending on clear relief and control.
films.music: fast rhythmic electronic beat with warm analog bass, 124 bpm, confident build and clean resolve
vo_mk: Пријава за штета, со два допири.

shots.kf: Vertical 9:16, Skopje Vardar quay café terrace, early morning golden light, muted Balkan palette of warm stone, river greens, and soft beige. Same hero in every shot: woman 30–35, dark bob hair, olive trench coat over cream knit, simple gold ring. Medium close-up, 35mm lens, hero seated at small wooden table with laptop open and a small espresso cup near the trackpad; her elbow clips the cup and coffee begins to spill toward the keyboard, face tense but clear.
shots.motion: Coffee tips and splashes onto the laptop keyboard as she jerks her hand back. Camera does a quick, controlled push-in from medium to tight on the spill, staying handheld but steady, five seconds.

shots.kf: Vertical 9:16, same table and props, same lighting and color palette, no readable text anywhere. Tight close-up, 50mm lens, soft natural side light from river direction. The laptop keyboard is visibly wet with dark coffee; napkin and cup remain in frame. Hero’s hands enter clearly: one hand holds a clean, unbranded smartphone; the other wipes the laptop edge with a plain white napkin. Her fingers tap the phone screen with calm urgency; screen content is abstract blur, no legible UI.
shots.motion: She stops wiping, brings the phone closer and makes two deliberate taps with her thumb. Camera makes a subtle tilt up from the wet keyboard to the phone in her hand, maintaining shallow depth of field in five seconds.

shots.kf: Vertical 9:16, same location on the Vardar quay, same hero and wardrobe, same table. Medium close-up, 35mm lens, balanced daylight now slightly brighter. The hero holds the phone low near the laptop; a simple, non-readable confirmation glow reflects on her face. She exhales and smiles with visible relief, shoulders dropping. The coffee cup sits tipped but stable; laptop remains in frame with a small puddle, emphasizing the real-world mishap. Background is softly blurred Balkan riverside walkway, signage-free.
shots.motion: She looks from the phone to the laptop, then relaxes and gives a small relieved nod. Camera slowly pulls back a few inches to reveal both her face and the damaged keyboard together, ending on her calm expression in five seconds.

films.desc_en: A single, coherent story following one Skopje resident along the Vardar quay: she photographs a minor car scratch, uploads it on a generic phone, receives approval, and gets the repaired car back at a small garage. One hero, one process, grounded North Macedonian realism, no signage or logos.
films.music: minimalist lo-fi corporate ambient track with light percussion, 100 bpm
vo_mk: Штетата ја пријавувате за минута, од телефон.
Сликајте го оштетувањето јасно, одблиску и оддалеку.
Прикачете и испратете — системот веднаш проверува.
Добивате одговор, па одите директно на сервис.

shots.kf: Late afternoon at the Vardar quay in Skopje, beside a parked compact silver car. Our hero, a woman in her early 30s with dark hair tied back, beige coat and black jeans, crouches by the rear bumper, studying a fresh scrape. Medium close-up, 35mm lens, soft overcast daylight, natural Balkan street textures, muted greys and warm skin tones, photorealistic, no readable text anywhere.
shots.motion: She runs two fingers gently along the scrape to show depth while the camera makes a slow handheld push-in from medium to tighter framing, keeping her hands and damage in focus within five seconds.

shots.kf: Same location and wardrobe. Over-the-shoulder view of the hero holding a matte black, logo-free smartphone. The phone camera is aimed at the scraped bumper; her hands are clean and steady, fingers clearly visible. Tight close-up, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, soft daylight reflections on metal, restrained palette of silver, beige, and charcoal, photorealistic, no text or icons readable on screen.
shots.motion: She takes two deliberate photos—one close, one slightly wider—by shifting her wrists a few centimeters, while the camera performs a subtle right-to-left slide to reveal both the bumper edge and her phone in one continuous move.

shots.kf: Still at the Vardar quay, the hero now stands beside the car, shoulders relaxed, looking down at the same logo-free phone. The screen is visible only as an indistinct glow; no interface details readable. Medium shot, 35mm lens, natural overcast light, background softly blurred with riverside railing and stone paving, consistent beige and charcoal wardrobe tones, photorealistic, calm and credible, no signage anywhere.
shots.motion: She taps once to upload and then lowers the phone slightly as if waiting; the camera slowly tilts down from her face to her hands, ending on the phone glow within five seconds.

shots.kf: Interior of a small, unbranded local garage in Skopje, warm practical lighting. The same hero stands beside her silver car with the mechanic’s hands visible only from the elbows down, no face shown. The rear bumper is now clean and aligned. Medium-wide shot, 28mm lens, warm tungsten mixed with soft window light, palette of concrete grey, beige coat, and neutral metal tones, photorealistic, no readable labels or logos.
shots.motion: The mechanic gently wipes the repaired bumper with a microfiber cloth in one smooth pass while the camera makes a slow dolly left, revealing the bumper surface catching the warm light and looking uniform.

shots.kf: Back at the Vardar quay, same time-of-day feel, same wardrobe, same car position. The hero stands by the rear bumper, now spotless, and slips the matte black phone into her coat pocket. Medium shot, 35mm lens, soft overcast daylight, consistent muted palette, photorealistic. The frame holds clean space on the right for an end card overlay; no real-world text or signage visible anywhere.
shots.motion: She closes the car door with a gentle push and takes one confident step forward; the camera slowly pulls back on a stabilised gimbal, widening to show her and the now-perfect bumper in a single continuous five-second move.

films.desc_en: An emotional and poetic cinematic montage celebrating the enduring peace of mind that comes with protecting what truly matters.
films.music: slow emotional modern orchestral string arrangement, 75 bpm
vo_mk: Животот е непроценлив подарок полн со спомени.
Заштитете ги оние што најмногу ги сакате.
Вашата сигурност е наша најголема обврска.

shots.kf: A traditional wooden boat gently floating on the calm, misty surface of Lake Ohrid just before sunrise. Cool blue and deep purple atmospheric tones, cinematic wide shot, fog hovering over the water, tranquil and silent, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The wooden boat gently bobs up and down on the calm water while the camera slowly tracks sideways.

shots.kf: A macro close-up of a thick, ancient oak tree trunk in a dense forest, soft golden sunlight filtering through the vibrant green canopy above. Rich textures of the tree bark, warm earthy tones, magical forest lighting, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The golden sunlight softly flickers through the moving leaves above, casting shifting shadows on the detailed tree bark.

shots.kf: Raindrops falling onto the sturdy red clay tiles of a traditional Macedonian roof, splashing gracefully. Moody, atmospheric overcast lighting, cinematic macro shot, deep terracotta reds and cool grey rain, highly detailed water textures, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The raindrops splash dynamically on the clay tiles in slow motion while the camera slowly pushes in.

shots.kf: A glowing golden lantern resting on a wooden porch, pushing back the deep blue twilight of the evening, creating a warm and safe haven. High contrast between the warm orange light and cool blue night, intimate setting, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The golden light from the lantern gently flickers on the wooden floorboards while the camera slowly dollies backward.

shots.kf: A heavy wooden front door with a brass handle, bathed in warm, welcoming interior light spilling out into the cool dark night. The feeling of arriving at a safe home. Medium shot, rich architectural details, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The warm light spilling from the door frame glows steadily while the camera subtly pans to the right.

shots.kf: A breathtaking panoramic wide shot of the bright sun rising over the majestic Shar Mountains, painting the clouds in brilliant hues of orange, pink, and gold. Vast landscape, hopeful and majestic atmosphere, crystal clear morning air, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The bright morning sunlight slowly creeps across the mountain peaks while the camera slowly glides forward.
